messages.content: Can I fly here this afternoon?

**Pilot's call this afternoon.** The forecast is workable from 10:00 to 14:00 GMT, with the best of it after 11:00.

- 10:00-11:00: wind is near your limit, so check the conditions below.
- NOTAM H7171/26 (parachute dropping) is within 2 NM. Contact 01632 960003 before flight. If H7171/26 is cancelled, the rest of the window is clear of it.
- NOTAM H7172/26 (air display rehearsal) is east of the field; its shape is approximate. NOTAM V32/26 is a crane to the south-west.
- The code `H7171/26` stays as written, and so does [H7171/26](https://example.invalid/notam) as a link. G9999/26 is not one of this turn's NOTAMs.
- Blue Mill ATZ is over the field from the surface to 2000 ft.

Decision support only: check the sources yourself before you fly.
